admission.justification: The default is realized in the Architect, Manager and Orchestrator role texts, the coordination operation, the router and four manifest descriptions, and the wording tests pin the current sentences that state it.

applicability: A native Architect that has work to delegate, on a supplied canonical task or on an explicitly selected taskless Projects launch after the developer selects it.
conditions: The launch supplies a supported role and canonical task references when task-bound.
A taskless Architect asks only for the missing outcome or registered repository before delegating.
The developer has not chosen the direct-coordination exception.
exclusions: The developer-chosen direct coordination and the single-master Orchestrator, which are the two named exceptions.
Dashboard starts of other roles, which keep their own launch and need no parent; that role independence is unrelated to the Architect's delegation duty.

statement: An architect that delegates hands coordination to exactly one agent, one Manager on the master for work inside one master or one Orchestrator on the sprint when two or more masters are worked on at the same time (the Orchestrator starting one Manager for each master), and the developer's two named choices, direct Architect coordination and an Orchestrator above a single master, are the only exceptions.
